architecture_decision.Data Model: Separate Company, Contact, Lead, Opportunity and Activity responsibilities.
architecture_decision.Pipeline: Use explicit qualification, quotation, negotiation and won/lost stages.
architecture_decision.Activity System: Store dated activities, owner, due date and next action.
architecture_decision.Automation: Run deterministic rules before probabilistic AI recommendations.
architecture_decision.AI Layer: Use evidence-backed summaries and next-best-action recommendations with human control.
architecture_decision.API: Expose stable object and workflow contracts through a versioned API boundary.
architecture_decision.Database: Use a relational source of truth with auditable identifiers and timestamps.
architecture_decision.Frontend: Keep operational CRM views separate from research evidence views while linking records.
architecture_decision.Integrations: Integrate prospecting and communication channels through explicit adapters.
architecture_decision.Skill Architecture: Use separate Builder and runtime Manager Skills with clear trigger boundaries.
architecture_decision.Agent Architecture: Keep research/decision authority separate from production mutation authority.
